# RAG-Based Q&A Feature — Architecture Plan

## Problem
The `ProductQA` Web API (.NET 10, minimal project) has markdown documentation in `Docs/` and needs a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline so users can ask natural-language questions and receive answers grounded in those docs.
